from pyspark.sql.functions import col, current_timestamp
from pyspark.sql.types import IntegerType

# -------------------------------
# READ ALL FILES FROM FOLDER
# -------------------------------
input_path = "abfss://raw@synapsedemo.dfs.core.windows.net/people/"
output_path = "abfss://curated@synapsedemo.dfs.core.windows.net/people_parquet/"

df = (
    spark.read
    .option("header", "true")
    .option("inferSchema", "true")
    .csv(input_path)
)

print("Total records read:", df.count())

# -------------------------------
# TRANSFORM
# -------------------------------
df_clean = (
    df
    .withColumnRenamed("First Name", "first_name")
    .withColumnRenamed("Last Name", "last_name")
    .withColumn("Age", col("Age").cast(IntegerType()))
    .filter(col("Age").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("ingestion_time", current_timestamp())

# -------------------------------
# WRITE OUTPUT
# -------------------------------
(
    df_clean
    .write
    .mode("overwrite")
    .parquet(output_path)
)

print("Data written to curated zone")
